items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ، إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَلَا نَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good that You know, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that You know, and I ask Your forgiveness for all that You know, for indeed You know and we do not know, and You are the Knower of the unseen.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma ta'lamu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma ta'lamu, wa astaghfiruka min kulli ma ta'lamu, innaka ta'lamu wa la na'lamu, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي مِنْ زَمَانِ هَذَا، وَإِحْدَاقِ الْفِتَنِ، وَتَوَلِّي أَهْلِ الْجُرْأَةِ عَلَيَّ، وَاسْتِضْعَافِهِمْ إِيَّايَ.
items.en: O Allah, have mercy on me in this age of mine, with trials surrounding me, and the bold ones turning against me, and their considering me weak.
items.translit: Allahummar-hamni min zamani hadha, wa ihdaqil-fitani, wa tawalli ahlil-jur'ati 'alayya, wastidh'afihim iyyaya.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْكَ فِي عِيَاذٍ مَنِيعٍ وَحِرْزٍ حَصِينٍ مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنِي أَجَلِي مُعَافًى.
items.en: O Allah, place me in an impregnable refuge and a secure protection from all of Your creation, until You bring me to the end of my term, safe and sound.
items.translit: Allahumma aj'alni minka fi 'iyadhin mani'in wa hirzin hasinin min jami'i khalqika hatta tuballighani ajali mu'afa.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ كَمَا تَنْبَغِي الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَجِبُ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad as many times as those who have sent blessings upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad as many times as those who have not sent blessings upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as blessings ought to be sent upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad as blessings are due upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad just as You commanded that blessings be sent upon him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man salla 'alayhi, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayhi, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi kama tanbaghis-salatu 'alayhi, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama tajibus-salatu 'alayhi, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama amarta an yusalla 'alayh.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي نُورُهُ مِنْ نُورِ الْأَنْوَارِ، وَأَشْرَقَ بِشُعَاعِ سِرِّهِ الْأَسْرَارُ.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose light is from the Light of Lights, and by the ray of whose secret all secrets were illuminated.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinil-ladhi nuruhu min nuril-anwar, wa ashraqa bi-shu'a'i sirrihil-asrar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الْأَبْرَارِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad and upon all the righteous People of his House.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ahli baytihil-abrari ajma'in.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ بَحْرِ أَنْوَارِكَ، وَمَعْدِنِ أَسْرَارِكَ، وَلِسَانِ حُجَّتِكَ، وَعَرُوسِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ، وَإِمَامِ حَضْرَتِكَ، وَخَاتَمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تَدُومُ بِدَوَامِكَ وَتَبْقَى بِبَقَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ وَتُرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, the sea of Your lights, the mine of Your secrets, the tongue of Your proof, the bridegroom of Your kingdom, the imam of Your presence, and the seal of Your prophets — blessings that endure as You endure and remain as You remain, blessings that please You and please him and through which You are pleased with us, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi bahri anwarika, wa ma'dini asrarika, wa lisani hujjatika, wa 'arusi mamlakatika, wa imami hadhratika, wa khatimi anbiya'ika, salatan tadumu bidawamika wa tabqa bibaqa'ika, salatan turdika wa turdihi wa turda biha 'anna, ya arhamar-rahimin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ، وَرَبَّ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الْبَيْتِ الْحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الرُّكْنِ وَالْمَقَامِ، أَبْلِغْ لِسَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنِّي السَّلَامَ.
items.en: O Allah, Lord of the sacred and the profane precincts, and Lord of the Sacred Site, and Lord of the Sacred House, and Lord of the Corner and the Station, convey to our master and mawla Muhammad, from me, a greeting of peace.
items.translit: Allahumma Rabbal-hilli wal-harami, wa Rabbal-mash'aril-harami, wa Rabbal-baytil-harami, wa Rabbar-rukni wal-maqami, abligh li-Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin minnis-salam.

lessons.title: Master of the First and the Last

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَحِينٍ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى يَرِثَ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and mawla Muhammad, the master of the first and the last, and send blessings upon our master and mawla Muhammad in every time and moment, and send blessings upon our master and mawla Muhammad in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgment, and send blessings upon our master and mawla Muhammad until he inherits the earth and whoever is upon it, and You are the Best of Inheritors.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin sayyidil-awwalina wal-akhirin, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin fi kulli waqtin wa hin, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin fil-mala'il-a'la ila yawmid-din, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin hatta yaritha-l-ardha wa man 'alayha wa anta khayrul-warithin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious. And bless our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-ummiyyi wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-ummiyyi kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَجَرَى بِهِ قَلَمُكَ، وَسَبَقَتْ بِهِ مَشِيئَتُكَ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ، بَاقِيَةً بِفَضْلِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ، إِلَى أَبَدِ الْأَبَدِ، أَبَدًا لَا نِهَايَةَ لِأَبَدِيَّتِهِ وَلَا فَنَاءَ لِدَيْمُومِيَّتِهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as Your knowledge encompasses, and Your pen has recorded, and Your will has preceded, and Your angels have blessed him — a blessing that endures as You endure, remaining by Your grace and favor, forever and ever, an eternity with no end to its eternity and no passing away to its continuance.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma ahata bihi 'ilmuka, wa jara bihi qalamuka, wa sabaqat bihi mashi'atuka, wa sallat 'alayhi mala'ikatuka, salatan da'imatan bidawamika, baqiyatan bifadhlika wa ihsanika, ila abadil-abadi, abadan la nihayata li-abadiyyatihi wa la fana'a li-daymumiyyatih.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، وَشَهِدَتْ بِهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، وَارْضَ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَارْحَمْ أُمَّتَهُ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book has counted, and Your angels have witnessed, and be pleased with his companions, and have mercy on his nation. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma ahata bihi 'ilmuka wa ahsahu kitabuka, wa shahidat bihi mala'ikatuka, wardha 'an ashabihi, warham ummatahu, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أَصْحَابِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad and upon all the companions of our master Muhammad.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala jami'i ashabi Sayyidina Muhammadin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima fil-'alamina, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا نَفَذَتْ بِهِ قُدْرَتُكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَصَّصَتْهُ إِرَادَتُكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا تَوَجَّهَ إِلَيْهِ أَمْرُكَ وَنَهْيُكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا وَسِعَهُ سَمْعُكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ بَصَرُكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and mawla Muhammad as many as Your knowledge encompasses, and as many as Your Book has counted, and as many as Your power has carried out, and as many as Your will has singled out, and as many as Your command and prohibition have addressed, and as many as Your hearing has encompassed, and as many as Your sight has encompassed, and as many times as the rememberers have remembered him, and as many times as the heedless have failed to remember him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin 'adada ma ahata bihi 'ilmuka, wa 'adada ma ahsahu kitabuka, wa 'adada ma nafadhat bihi qudratuka, wa 'adada ma khassasat-hu iradatuka, wa 'adada ma tawajjaha ilayhi amruka wa nahyuka, wa 'adada ma wasi'ahu sam'uka, wa 'adada ma ahata bihi basaruka, wa 'adada ma dhakarahudh-dhakirun, wa 'adada ma ghafala 'an dhikrihil-ghafilun.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ عَدَدَ قَطْرِ الْأَمْطَارِ، وَعَدَدَ أَوْرَاقِ الْأَشْجَارِ، وَعَدَدَ دَوَابِّ الْقِفَارِ، وَعَدَدَ دَوَابِّ الْبِحَارِ، وَعَدَدَ مِيَاهِ الْبِحَارِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ، وَعَدَدَ الرِّمَالِ، وَعَدَدَ النِّسَاءِ وَالرِّجَالِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِكَ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَمِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَأَرْضِكَ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ، أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ.
items.en: And send blessings upon him as many as the drops of rain, and as many as the leaves of the trees, and as many as the creatures of the deserts, and as many as the creatures of the seas, and as many as the waters of the seas, and as many times as night has darkened over it and day has shone upon it, morning and evening, and as many as the grains of sand, and as many as women and men, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the ink of Your words, filling Your heavens and Your earth, and the weight of Your Throne, and as many as Your creations — the best of Your blessings.
items.translit: Wa salli 'alayhi 'adada qatril-amtar, wa 'adada awraqil-ashjar, wa 'adada dawabbil-qifar, wa 'adada dawabbil-bihar, wa 'adada miyahil-bihar, wa 'adada ma azlama 'alayhil-laylu wa adha'a 'alayhin-nahar, bil-ghuduwwi wal-asal, wa 'adadar-rimal, wa 'adadan-nisa'i war-rijal, wa ridha'a nafsika, wa midada kalimatika, wa mil'a samawatika wa ardhika, wa zinata 'arshika, wa 'adada makhluqatika, afdhala salawatik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Prophet of Mercy.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى شَفِيعِ الْأُمَّةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Intercessor of the Nation.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى كَاشِفِ الْغُمَّةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Remover of Anguish.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُجْلِي الظُّلْمَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Dispeller of Darkness.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُولِي النِّعْمَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Bestower of Favor.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُعْطِي الرَّحْمَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Giver of Mercy.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْحَوْضِ الْمَوْرُودِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Frequented Pool.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْمَقَامِ الْمَحْمُودِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Praised Station.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ اللِّوَاءِ الْمَعْقُودِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Banner of Praise.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْمَكَانِ الْمَشْهُودِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Witnessed Station.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمَوْصُوفِ بِالْكَرَمِ وَالْجُودِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the One Described with Generosity and Bounty.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ هُوَ فِي السَّمَاءِ سَيِّدُنَا مَحْمُودٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him who in heaven is our master Mahmud (the Praised One) and on earth is our master Muhammad.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man huwa fis-sama'i Sayyiduna Mahmudun wa fil-ardhi Sayyiduna Muhammad.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الشَّامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Distinguishing Mark.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْعَلَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Sign.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمَوْصُوفِ بِالْكَرَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the One Described with Nobility.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمَخْصُوصِ بِالزَّعَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the One Specially Endowed with Leadership.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَتْ تُظِلُّهُ الْغَمَامَةُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him whom the cloud used to shade.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ يَرَى خَلْفَهُ كَمَا يَرَى مَنْ أَمَامَهُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him who saw behind him as he saw before him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man kana yara khalfahu kama yara man amamah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ الْمُشَفَّعِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Intercessor whose Intercession is Accepted on the Day of Resurrection.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الذِّرْوَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Summit of Honor.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الشَّفَاعَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Intercession.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْوَسِيلَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Wasila.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْفَضِيلَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Excellence.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Elevated Rank.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْهِرَاوَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Staff.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ النَّعْلَيْنِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Two Sandals.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْحُجَجِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Proofs.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْبُرْهَانِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Clear Evidence.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ السُّلْطَانِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Authority.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ التَّاجِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Crown.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْمِعْرَاجِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Night Ascension.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْقَضِيبِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Staff.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَاكِبِ النَّجِيبِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Rider of the Noble Camel.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَاكِبِ الْبُرَاقِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Rider of Buraq.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُخْتَرِقِ السَّبْعِ الطِّبَاقِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the One Who Traversed the Seven Heavens.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ فِي جَمِيعِ الْأَنَامِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Intercessor for All Creation.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَبَّحَ فِي كَفِّهِ الطَّعَامُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him in whose palm the food glorified Allah.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man sabbaha fi kaffihit-ta'am.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بَكَى إِلَيْهِ الْجِذْعُ وَحَنَّ لِفِرَاقِهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him to whom the palm trunk wept and yearned at his parting.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man baka ilayhil-jidh'u wa hanna li-firaqih.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَوَسَّلَ بِهِ طَيْرُ الْفَلَاةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him through whom the bird of the wilderness sought intercession.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man tawassala bihi tayrul-falah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَبَّحَتْ فِي كَفِّهِ الْحَصَى.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him in whose palm the pebbles glorified Allah.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man sabbahat fi kaffihil-hasa.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَشَفَّعَ إِلَيْهِ الظَّبْيُ بِأَفْصَحِ الْكَلَامِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him to whom the gazelle pleaded in the clearest speech.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man tashaffa'a ilayhizh-zhabyu bi-afsahil-kalam.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَلَّمَهُ الضَّبُّ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ الْعِلْمِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him to whom the lizard spoke in his gathering, among his learned companions.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man kallamahudh-dhabbu fi majlisihi ma'a ashabihil-'ilm.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْبَشِيرِ النَّذِيرِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Bearer of Glad Tidings and the Warner.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى السِّرَاجِ الْمُنِيرِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Illuminating Lamp.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ شَكَا إِلَيْهِ الْبَعِيرُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him to whom the camel complained.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَفَجَّرَ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ الْمَاءُ النَّمِيرُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him from between whose fingers gushed abundant water.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man tafajjara min bayni asabi'ihil-ma'un-namir.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الطَّاهِرِ الْمُطَهَّرِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Pure, the Purified.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نُورِ الْأَنْوَارِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Light of Lights.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنِ انْشَقَّ لَهُ الْقَمَرُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him for whom the moon was split.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الطَّيِّبِ الْمُطَيَّبِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Good, the Purified.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ الْمُقَرَّبِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Messenger Brought Near.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْفَجْرِ السَّاطِعِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Shining Dawn.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّجْمِ الثَّاقِبِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Piercing Star.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Firmest Handhold.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نَذِيرِ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Warner of the People of the Earth.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ يَوْمَ الْعَرْضِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Intercessor on the Day of Presentation.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى السَّاقِي لِلنَّاسِ مِنَ الْحَوْضِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the One Who Gives the People to Drink from the Pool.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ لِوَاءِ الْحَمْدِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Banner of Praise.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُشَمِّرِ عَنْ سَاعِدِ الْجِدِّ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him who strove earnestly with all seriousness.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُسْتَعْمِلِ فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ غَايَةَ الْجُهْدِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him who exerted the utmost effort in seeking Your pleasure.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala al-musta'mili fi mardhatika ghayatal-juhd.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الْخَاتِمِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Seal of the Prophets.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ الْخَاتِمِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Seal of the Messengers.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى الْقَائِمِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Chosen One, the Established.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَسُولِكَ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Your messenger, Abul-Qasim.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْآيَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Signs.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الدَّلَالَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Indications.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْإِشَارَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Allusions.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْكَرَامَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Miraculous Graces.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْعَلَامَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Signs.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْبَيِّنَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Clear Proofs.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الْمُعْجِزَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Miracles.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ خَوَارِقِ الْعَادَاتِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Extraordinary Wonders.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَلَّمَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْأَحْجَارُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him to whom the stones gave greeting.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَجَدَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ الْأَشْجَارُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him before whom the trees prostrated.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man sajadat bayna yadayhil-ashjar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ طَابَتْ بِبَرَكَتِهِ الثِّمَارُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him by whose blessing the fruits were made good.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنِ اخْضَرَّتْ مِمَّا بَقِيَ مِنْ وُضُوئِهِ الْأَشْجَارُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him from the remains of whose ablution-water the trees turned green.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala manikh-darrat mimma baqiya min wudhu'ihil-ashjar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ فَاضَتْ مِنْ نُورِهِ جَمِيعُ الْأَنْوَارِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him from whose light all lights flowed.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man fadhat min nurihi jami'ul-anwar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُحَطُّ الْأَوْزَارُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him by sending blessings upon whom burdens are removed.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ مَنَازِلُ الْأَبْرَارِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him by sending blessings upon whom the ranks of the righteous are attained.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man bis-salati 'alayhi tunalu manazilul-abrar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ يُرْحَمُ الْكِبَارُ وَالصِّغَارُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him by sending blessings upon whom the old and the young are shown mercy.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man bis-salati 'alayhi yurhamul-kibaru was-sighar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ نَتَنَعَّمُ فِي هَذِهِ الدَّارِ وَفِي تِلْكَ الدَّارِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him by sending blessings upon whom we are blessed in this life and in the next.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man bis-salati 'alayhi natana'am fi hadhihid-dari wa fi tilkad-dar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ رَحْمَةُ الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّارِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him by sending blessings upon whom the mercy of the Almighty, the All-Forgiving is attained.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man bis-salati 'alayhi tunalu rahmatul-'azizil-ghaffar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمَنْصُورِ الْمُؤَيَّدِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Aided, the Supported.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ الْمُمَجَّدِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Chosen, the Glorified.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and mawla Muhammad.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammad.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ إِذَا مَشَى فِي الْبَرِّ الْأَقْفَارِ تَعَلَّقَتِ الْوُحُوشُ بِأَذْيَالِهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon him who, when he walked in the barren wilderness, the wild animals clung to the hems of his garment.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala man kana idha masha fil-barril-aqfar ta'allaqatil-wuhushu bi-adhyalih.

items.ar: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: May Allah's blessings be upon him and upon his family and companions, and grant abundant peace, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Sallallahu 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallama tasliman, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، وَمِنَ الذُّلِّ إِلَّا لَكَ، وَمِنَ الْخَوْفِ إِلَّا مِنْكَ.
items.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, except poverty toward You, and from abasement, except before You, and from fear, except of You.
items.translit: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-faqri illa ilayk, wa minadh-dhulli illa lak, wa minal-khawfi illa mink.

items.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَقُولَ زُورًا، أَوْ أَغْشَى فُجُورًا، أَوْ أَكُونَ بِكَ مَغْرُورًا.
items.en: And I seek refuge in You from saying falsehood, or committing indecency, or being deluded about You.
items.translit: Wa a'udhu bika an aqula zuran, aw aghsha fujuran, aw akuna bika maghrura.

items.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ، وَذُلِّ الدَّيْنِ، وَخَيْبَةِ الرَّجَاءِ، وَزَوَالِ النِّعْمَةِ، وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقْمَةِ.
items.en: And I seek refuge in You from the gloating of enemies, the humiliation of debt, disappointed hope, the departure of blessing, and the sudden onset of punishment.
items.translit: Wa a'udhu bika min shamatatil-a'da'i, wa dhullid-dayni, wa khaybatir-raja'i, wa zawalin-ni'mati, wa fuja'atin-niqmah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، حَبِيبُكَ. (ثَلَاثًا)
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and grant him peace, and reward him on our behalf as he deserves — Your beloved. (recited three times)
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa sallim 'alayhi wajzihi 'anna ma huwa ahluhu, habibuka. (thalathan)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، خَلِيلُكَ. (ثَلَاثًا)
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Ibrahim and grant him peace, and reward him on our behalf as he deserves — Your intimate friend. (recited three times)
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa sallim 'alayhi wajzihi 'anna ma huwa ahluhu, khaliluka. (thalathan)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَا نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed, showed mercy, and blessed our master Ibrahim in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious — as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta wa rahimta wa barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima fil-'alamina, innaka Hamidun Majid, 'adada khalqika wa ridha'a nafsika wa zinata 'arshika wa midada kalimatik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَضْعَافَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، وَكَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَاهُ لَهُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those who sent blessings upon him, and as many as those who did not send blessings upon him, and as many times as blessings have been sent upon him, and multiples of that, as he deserves, and as You love and are pleased for him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man salla 'alayhi, wa 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayhi, wa 'adada ma sulliya 'alayhi, wa adh'afa ma sulliya 'alayhi, kama huwa ahluhu, wa kama tuhibbu wa tardhahu lah.
